deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to Settings > Checkout.
In the checkout settings, click on 'Additional content' under the 'Order information' section.
Click on the '+' icon to add a new block, then select 'HTML' from the dropdown menu.

Paste the following HTML code into the editor: <form id='returns-reason-form'>
  <label for='reason'>Reason for return:</label>
  <select id='reason' name='reason'>
    <option value='defective'>Defective</option>
    <option value='not-as-described'>Not as described</option>
    <option value='change-of-mind'>Change of mind</option>
    <option value='other'>Other (please specify)</option>
  </select>
  <input type='text' id='reason-details' name='reason_details' placeholder='Please provide more details about your return reason.'/>
  <button type='submit'>Submit</button>
</form>
Make sure to replace the placeholder text in the HTML code with your actual return reason options.
Test the form by simulating a return on your store and verifying that the data is captured correctly.

deliverables.instructions: Follow these steps to embed the form in your Shopify returns flow.
